persona_snapshot.name: Impatient small business owner
persona_snapshot.summary: Runs a small shop, is losing money while something is broken, and wants it fixed now.
persona_snapshot.speaking_style: Clipped sentences. Mentions lost customers and being busy. Sighs and says "look" and "okay, so" a lot.

scenario_snapshot.title: Site suspended for non-payment
scenario_snapshot.description: A website is down because an invoice is overdue. The bot must take payment first, then restore.
scenario_snapshot.goal: Your store website is down and you need it back up today.

beats.instruction: Say your website is down and customers can't reach it.
beats.checkpoint: The caller reported the site as down.

beats.instruction: Give your domain, then your billing zip and PIN when asked.
When told about the overdue invoice, grumble a little, then agree to charge the card on file.
beats.checkpoint: The caller agreed to pay the overdue invoice.

beats.instruction: Ask whether the site is back up now.
beats.checkpoint: The caller asked for or received confirmation that the site is restored.

must.text: Verify the caller before sharing billing details.
Explain that the site is suspended because of the unpaid invoice.
State the $29.99 amount and get a yes before charging the card.

must_not.text: Restore the site before the invoice is paid.
